summary: Comprehensive architectural and visual masterplan to elevate Vivida into a Swiss-Grid Astronomical Almanac & Editorial Celestial experience, featuring an interactive astrolabe and live sky dial hero, a unified top bar with persistent celestial context strip and slide-over navigation drawer, bespoke geometric SVG celestial/lunar illustrations, and a cohesive 1px hairline ledger architecture across landing, public hubs, and authenticated workspaces.
